name: rtc_calendar
description: RTC_Calendar: the RTC on LSI (the example's MSP selects RCC_RTCCLKSOURCE_LSI, its comment saying LSE) with LSE's prescalers (0x7F, 0xFF), so each of its seconds lasts 32768 / 32000 s; set to 02:00:00 on 14 April 2015, the backup register DR1 marked; the time and date are formatted into aShowTime and aShowDate as they count.
